summary.text: Bob Brinson is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 3 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Charles Dudley.
He holds a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point.

paragraphs.text: Brinson assumed office in the Senate on January 1, 2025, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his education as a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point.
The General Assembly's website lists his district as covering Beaufort, Craven and Lenoir counties.

It shows his committee assignments in Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Appropriations on Agriculture, Natural, and Economic Resources; Education/Higher Education; State and Local Government; and Transportation, along with the Select Committee on Property Tax Reform.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
